text: `shell_completions.go` provides flag annotations used by shell completion. `MarkFlagRequired` marks a flag with `BashCompOneRequiredFlag` (`shell_completions.go:21-23,35-40`), while `Command.MarkFlagFilename` and `Command.MarkPersistentFlagFilename` restrict completion to specified file extensions on local and persistent flag sets respectively (`shell_completions.go:42-46,58-63`).
